F2 · ServerFileRepository 缺少带主体过滤的内容读取 API，应用只能重写整套字节路由

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

FileOperations 只提供 validateCollection/uploadOne/uploadMany/getUrl/getStorageUrl，公开字节路由又是无认证的例外。要满足“附件仅本人可读”，应用别无选择：解析 driveManagerToken 与 databaseManagerToken，在 material-content.ts 里自己写 UUID 正则、ownerId 过滤、disk.exists、404 语义、Cache-Control/nosniff/CSP/Content-Disposition，再用 Readable.toWeb(getStream) 返回字节——与插件 routes.js 中公开路由的实现几乎逐行重复。Skill 要求应用“先加 scoped middleware 和 principal-based Policy”，但公开 ServerFileRepositoryManager 并未暴露可承载这层 Policy 的读取入口。

实际影响
每个需要私有附件的应用都要复制一遍易错的安全头、404 等价性与流式实现；不同实现的细微差异（例如漏掉 nosniff 或把越权记录当成 200）难以被框架约束。
建议改法
在 ServerFileRepositoryManager/FileOperations 上提供可选主体上下文的读取/流式方法（或在 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 内建应用可注入的认证与授权钩子），让应用复用同一套安全头与记录判定。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
需要把附件限制为仅上传者/本人可读，且希望复用框架的字节路由语义。
应有能力 / 行为
框架提供带 principal/Policy 的内容读取能力，应用只需注入认证与过滤规则。
实际观察
框架只提供公开、无认证的字节路由与不含读取操作的 Repository 接口，应用必须自建根路由并重复安全头/流逻辑。
应用绕行与代价
material-content.ts 解析 driveManagerToken+databaseManagerToken，按 ownerId 过滤并自行设置 nosniff/CSP/Content-Disposition 与流式响应。
改进后的验收标准
应用在不复制流/头逻辑的前提下注册受保护字节路由，且匿名/越权仍为 401/404。

export interface FileOperations {
    validateCollection(): Promise<void>;
    uploadOne(input: UploadOneInput): Promise<UploadOneResult>;
    uploadMany(input: UploadManyInput): Promise<UploadManyResult>;
    getUrl(record: Pick<FileRecord, 'id' | 'ext'>): string;
    getStorageUrl(record: Pick<FileRecord, 'disk' | 'key'>): Promise<string>;
}
export type ServerFileRepository = Repository<FileRecord> & FileOperations;
/**
 * The columns a file Collection must provide, which are also the columns
 * `store()` composes for every upload.
 */
export declare const FILE_COLUMNS: readonly ["id", "disk", "key", "filename", "ext", "mimeType", "size", "createdAt", "updatedAt"];
/**
 * The Policy the upload path binds, derived from the exposure's own.
 *
 * It is derived rather than used as it stands because an upload supplies no
 * caller fields at all — `store()` composes every value — so a field allowlist
 * has nothing to constrain here and the plugin substitutes its own columns.
 * What is inherited is exactly the two dimensions that do not describe caller
 * input: which rows this principal may produce (`scope`), and what the server
 * stamps onto them (`defaults`). A `create` that is `false` stays `false`, so
 * an exposure that forbids creating rows forbids uploading them too.
 *
 * This is the only place a Policy is widened, and the reason is specific to
 * this path. It licenses nothing elsewhere.
 */
export declare function uploadPolicy(base: RepositoryPolicy): RepositoryPolicy;

packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126E16

Skill 明确：action 由 policy 管，accessPath 下的内容路由是公开例外；“For restricted files, register App-owned authentication … before mounting it”；“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.
app/server/routes/material-content.ts:14–72E22

应用自建 defineRootRoutes 认证字节路由：复制 UUID 正则、ownerId 过滤、disk.exists、Cache-Control/nsniff/CSP/Content-Disposition 与 getStream，说明框架未提供可直接复用的带策略内容读取。

/**
 * The authenticated byte route for material attachments.
 *
 * The File Repository's own byte route is deliberately public — it serves anyone holding the UUID and is not
 * reached by a Policy. The product requires the opposite: an attachment belongs to the user who uploaded it, and
 * neither a colleague with the link nor a signed-out visitor may read it. So this application serves the bytes
 * itself, from the same `local` disk the upload wrote to, and looks the record up with the caller's id in the
 * filter. A missing record, another user's record and a non-`png`/`docx` record are indistinguishable: all 404.
 */

const UUID =
  /^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?:\.([a-z0-9]{1,32}))?$/;

const MIME_TYPES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  png: 'image/png',
  docx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
};

export default defineRootRoutes((app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);

  router.get('/uploads/materials/:file', auth.required(), async (context) => {
    const session = context.get('auth');
    if (!session) return context.json({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);

    const match = UUID.exec(context.req.param('file'));
    if (!match) return context.notFound();

    const [, id, extension = ''] = match;
    if (!(extension in MIME_TYPES)) return context.notFound();

    const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
    const record = await database
      .repository<MaterialAttachmentRecord>('material_files')
      .findOne({ filter: { id, ownerId: session.user.id } });
    if (!record || record.ext !== extension) return context.notFound();

    const disk = app.container.resolve(driveManagerToken).use(record.disk);
    if (!(await disk.exists(record.key))) return context.notFound();

    const filename = encodeURIComponent(
      Buffer.from(record.filename).toString('utf8'),
    ).replace(
      /['()*]/g,
      (char) => `%${char.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`,
    );

    context.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
    context.header('Content-Type', MIME_TYPES[extension]);
    context.header('Content-Length', String(record.size));
    context.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    context.header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox; default-src 'none'");
    context.header(
      'Content-Disposition',
      `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''${filename}`,
    );
    return context.body(Readable.toWeb(await disk.getStream(record.key)));
  });

### [轻微][能力缺口] ServerFileRepository 缺少带主体过滤的内容读取 API，应用只能重写整套字节路由

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）、`packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md`

FileOperations 只提供 validateCollection/uploadOne/uploadMany/getUrl/getStorageUrl，公开字节路由又是无认证的例外。要满足“附件仅本人可读”，应用别无选择：解析 driveManagerToken 与 databaseManagerToken，在 material-content.ts 里自己写 UUID 正则、ownerId 过滤、disk.exists、404 语义、Cache-Control/nosniff/CSP/Content-Disposition，再用 Readable.toWeb(getStream) 返回字节——与插件 routes.js 中公开路由的实现几乎逐行重复。Skill 要求应用“先加 scoped middleware 和 principal-based Policy”，但公开 ServerFileRepositoryManager 并未暴露可承载这层 Policy 的读取入口。

**影响**：每个需要私有附件的应用都要复制一遍易错的安全头、404 等价性与流式实现；不同实现的细微差异（例如漏掉 nosniff 或把越权记录当成 200）难以被框架约束。

**建议改动**：在 ServerFileRepositoryManager/FileOperations 上提供可选主体上下文的读取/流式方法（或在 defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 内建应用可注入的认证与授权钩子），让应用复用同一套安全头与记录判定。

**验收标准**：应用在不复制流/头逻辑的前提下注册受保护字节路由，且匿名/越权仍为 401/404。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/repository.d.ts:16–43` — FileOperations 仅暴露 validateCollection/uploadOne/uploadMany/getUrl/getStorageUrl，没有按主体读取内容的流式 API；FILE_COLUMNS 固定九列；uploadPolicy 说明上传路径如何从 exposure 的 Policy 派生。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/repository.js:122–162` — store() 用 randomUUID() 铸 id、清洗文件名、合成 objects/<id>.<ext> key、disk.putStream、比对 contentLength 并抛 INVALID_FILE_METADATA；是上传字节与元数据由框架负责的可执行证据。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126` — Skill 明确：action 由 policy 管，accessPath 下的内容路由是公开例外；“For restricted files, register App-owned authentication … before mounting it”；“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。
- `app/server/routes/material-content.ts:14–72` — 应用自建 defineRootRoutes 认证字节路由：复制 UUID 正则、ownerId 过滤、disk.exists、Cache-Control/nsniff/CSP/Content-Disposition 与 getStream，说明框架未提供可直接复用的带策略内容读取。

轻微指引缺失上游未复核
F5 · db Skill 未说明 uuid 主键无数据库默认值时需由调用方提供 id

文档 / Skill / 示例 · @nocobase/db · packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md · 原评审：未解决

⌄

nocobase-db SKILL 的边界清单写了 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”，方向正确但没有覆盖最常见的正向场景：用 collection.uuid("id").primary() 声明的主键没有数据库默认值，Repository 的 createdRecordSelector 只回填 autoIncrement/increments，因此 createOne 省略 id 时会由 recordSelector 抛 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR。应用为此在 provider 里显式 id: randomUUID()。迁移模板与 Skill 都没有把这一职责写清楚。

实际影响
使用 uuid 主键的开发者会先撞上运行时的 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR，再自行推断出“需要自己铸 id 或加数据库默认”，增加试错成本并容易在不同表间写出不一致的身份策略。
建议改法
在 nocobase-db Skill（及迁移示例）中补一段：uuid primary 无默认值时，createOne/upsertOne 必须显式提供 id（或声明数据库默认/服务端默认），并给出 randomUUID 示例。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
声明 collection.uuid("id").primary() 后在 createOne 中省略 id。
应有能力 / 行为
文档明确 uuid 主键的身份生成职责与写法，或库有默认生成。
实际观察
Skill 仅提醒不要假设 id 存在，未说明 uuid 需调用方提供；运行时才以 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR 暴露。
应用绕行与代价
应用在每次 createOne 时用 node:crypto randomUUID() 显式提供 id。
改进后的验收标准
Skill 或迁移示例给出 uuid 主键的 id 提供方式，开发者不再需要靠报错误推。
评审时证据 · 冻结快照 4 条
packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/internal/identity.js:9–34E10

recordSelector 在找不到“完整且非空”的主键/唯一约束时抛 RepositoryError("INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR",…)；createdRecordSelector 只为 autoIncrement/increments 回填生成的 id，不覆盖 uuid。

export function recordSelector(collection, record) {
    const constraint = identityConstraints(collection).find((candidate) => candidate.fields.every((field) => record[field] !== undefined && record[field] !== null));
    if (!constraint) {
        throw new RepositoryError('INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR', 'Repository record requires a complete, non-null primary or unconditional unique selector.', { collection: collection.name });
    }
    return {
        kind: 'unique',
        fields: [...constraint.fields],
        values: Object.fromEntries(constraint.fields.map((field) => [field, record[field]])),
    };
}
export function createdRecordSelector(collection, values, returned) {
    const record = { ...values };
    const generated = (collection.fields ?? []).filter((field) => !('target' in field) &&
        (field.autoIncrement || field.type === 'increments'));
    const insertId = Array.isArray(returned) ? returned[0] : undefined;
    // Drivers without RETURNING may supply one generated numeric identity, not a value for every primary field.
    if (generated.length === 1 &&
        (typeof insertId === 'number' ||
            typeof insertId === 'string' ||
            typeof insertId === 'bigint')) {
        const field = generated[0].name;
        if (record[field] === undefined)
            record[field] = insertId;
    }
    return recordSelector(collection, record);
packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:242–249E18

db Skill 的边界清单：包含 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”；但没有说明 uuid 主键在未声明数据库默认值时必须由调用方提供 id。

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
- Do not assume an `id` exists, and do not infer a field's type, primary key or auto-increment from its name.

应用 service 在 createOne 时显式 id: randomUUID()，并注释“Collection declares a uuid primary key but no database default, so the row identity is application-owned”。

  public async createOwned(
    ownerId: string,
    input: MaterialInput,
  ): Promise<MaterialWithAttachments> {
    const title = this.normalizeTitle(input.title);
    const attachmentIds = await this.resolveAttachmentIds(
      ownerId,
      input.attachmentIds,
    );
    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    const created = await this.materials.createOne({
      values: {
        // The Collection declares a uuid primary key but no database default, so the row's identity is
        // application-owned — the same way the File Repository's upload path mints its own file ids.
        id: randomUUID(),
        title,
        ownerId,
        createdAt: now,
        updatedAt: now,
      },
    });
    const id = created.record.id;
    await this.syncAttachments(ownerId, id, attachmentIds, now);

    const material = await this.getOwned(ownerId, id);
    if (!material) {
      throw new MaterialsError(
        'ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND',
        'The material could not be read back after it was created.',
      );
    }
    return material;
  }

### [轻微][指引缺失] db Skill 未说明 uuid 主键无数据库默认值时需由调用方提供 id

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/db`（评审时 1.0.0-beta.16）、`packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md`

nocobase-db SKILL 的边界清单写了 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”，方向正确但没有覆盖最常见的正向场景：用 collection.uuid("id").primary() 声明的主键没有数据库默认值，Repository 的 createdRecordSelector 只回填 autoIncrement/increments，因此 createOne 省略 id 时会由 recordSelector 抛 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR。应用为此在 provider 里显式 id: randomUUID()。迁移模板与 Skill 都没有把这一职责写清楚。

**影响**：使用 uuid 主键的开发者会先撞上运行时的 INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR，再自行推断出“需要自己铸 id 或加数据库默认”，增加试错成本并容易在不同表间写出不一致的身份策略。

**建议改动**：在 nocobase-db Skill（及迁移示例）中补一段：uuid primary 无默认值时，createOne/upsertOne 必须显式提供 id（或声明数据库默认/服务端默认），并给出 randomUUID 示例。

**验收标准**：Skill 或迁移示例给出 uuid 主键的 id 提供方式，开发者不再需要靠报错误推。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/db/dist/src/repository/internal/identity.js:9–34` — recordSelector 在找不到“完整且非空”的主键/唯一约束时抛 RepositoryError("INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR",…)；createdRecordSelector 只为 autoIncrement/increments 回填生成的 id，不覆盖 uuid。
- `packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:242–249` — db Skill 的边界清单：包含 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”；但没有说明 uuid 主键在未声明数据库默认值时必须由调用方提供 id。
- `app/server/providers/materials.ts:152–185` — 应用 service 在 createOne 时显式 id: randomUUID()，并注释“Collection declares a uuid primary key but no database default, so the row identity is application-owned”。
- `app/database/main/migrations/202609010001_create_materials.ts:16–56` — 迁移用 collection.uuid("id").primary() 但未设数据库默认值；同时定义 material_files 的文件列与 ownerId/materialId 两个应用列。

F3 · 注册表图片预览器缺少失败态，损坏 PNG 会被静默当作成功预览

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支直接渲染裸 <img src={url}>，没有 onError，也没有围绕加载失败的状态或下载回退（外部 error prop 只覆盖调用方已知错误）。相较之下 Office/OOXML 分支都有 error → 下载卡片的回退。于是损坏 PNG 会保留浏览器坏图标，而周围 UI 仍显示文件名，看起来像“预览成功”。应用为了满足 B06，只能在 app-owned 的注册表副本里新增 ImagePreview（onError + role=alert + 下载按钮）。

实际影响
开发者若直接复用框架组件，损坏图片不会进入任何失败路径，验收“损坏文件要有明确失败提示”的用例会失败，且不同应用会各自造一套不一致的失败 UI。
建议改法
在框架的 image 分支内建 onError 失败态与下载回退（可复用现有 office 回退组件），使所有复用者默认获得一致行为。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
上传内容损坏或不可解码的图片（或磁盘文件与元数据不一致）。
应有能力 / 行为
预览器捕获 onError，给出明确的“无法显示/文件已保存”提示并保留下载入口。
实际观察
默认 image 分支无 onError，损坏图片被当作已渲染，无任何失败提示。
应用绕行与代价
应用在 app-owned 注册表副本中新增 ImagePreview，捕获 onError 后渲染 alert 与下载按钮。
改进后的验收标准
框架默认组件直接复用即可通过 B06，无需应用改写注册表组件。

app/client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:104–159E25

应用在 app-owned 注册表副本中新增 ImagePreview：捕获 onError 并给出 role=alert 的损坏提示与下载按钮——因为框架默认图片预览没有失败态。

/**
 * An image preview that admits when it cannot decode the bytes.
 *
 * The `<img>` this replaces had no failure state: a damaged PNG kept the browser's broken-image icon (or, in some
 * browsers, nothing) and the surrounding chrome still showed the filename as though the preview had succeeded. A
 * corrupt upload has to be reported as a failed preview, so this tracks the load error and replaces the image with an
 * alert that says the content is damaged, keeping the download action available so the user can still inspect it.
 */
function ImagePreview(inputProps: {
  readonly file: FileRecord;
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly onDownload?: () => void;
}): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file');
  const { file, url, onDownload } = inputProps;
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <div
        role='alert'
        className='flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center'
      >
        <ImageOff
          aria-hidden='true'
          className='size-10 text-muted-foreground'
        />
        <p className='font-medium'>
          {t('files.imageFailed', {
            defaultValue: 'This image cannot be displayed',
          })}
        </p>
        <p className='max-w-md text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          {t('files.imageFailedDescription', {
            defaultValue:
              'The file is saved, but it is damaged or not a readable image, so it cannot be previewed. Download it to inspect it.',
          })}
        </p>
        {onDownload ? (
          <Button type='button' onClick={onDownload}>
            {t('files.downloadFile', { defaultValue: 'Download file' })}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img
      src={url}
      alt={file.filename}
      className='max-h-[70vh] max-w-full object-contain'
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
    />
  );
}

### [轻微][易用性改进] 注册表图片预览器缺少失败态，损坏 PNG 会被静默当作成功预览

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）

file-preview-content.tsx 的 image 分支直接渲染裸 <img src={url}>，没有 onError，也没有围绕加载失败的状态或下载回退（外部 error prop 只覆盖调用方已知错误）。相较之下 Office/OOXML 分支都有 error → 下载卡片的回退。于是损坏 PNG 会保留浏览器坏图标，而周围 UI 仍显示文件名，看起来像“预览成功”。应用为了满足 B06，只能在 app-owned 的注册表副本里新增 ImagePreview（onError + role=alert + 下载按钮）。

**影响**：开发者若直接复用框架组件，损坏图片不会进入任何失败路径，验收“损坏文件要有明确失败提示”的用例会失败，且不同应用会各自造一套不一致的失败 UI。

**建议改动**：在框架的 image 分支内建 onError 失败态与下载回退（可复用现有 office 回退组件），使所有复用者默认获得一致行为。

**验收标准**：框架默认组件直接复用即可通过 B06，无需应用改写注册表组件。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:61–99` — kind==="image" 直接返回裸 <img src={url}>，没有 onError/失败态；error 只在 switch 之前被处理（外部传入）。对比 office/ooxml 分支均有错误回退。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx:80–113` — OOXML 预览有 viewerError/AbortController/onError 回退到下载卡片，但只在 !loaded 时无限显示 “Loading preview...”，没有像旧 Office iframe 那样的 15s 加载超时。
- `app/client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:104–159` — 应用在 app-owned 注册表副本中新增 ImagePreview：捕获 onError 并给出 role=alert 的损坏提示与下载按钮——因为框架默认图片预览没有失败态。
- `artifacts/verify-3/browser-acceptance/report.json:1–25` — verify-3 report：passed=false, authenticated=true；B01/B03/B04/B05/B06 passed，B02 blocked（agent-browser 包装 window.Worker 导致 module blob worker 收不到首批消息，原生 Worker 可渲染）。

F4 · OfficeOpenXmlPreview 没有加载超时，viewer 卡住时会永久停在 Loading preview…

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · 原评审：未解决

⌄

OOXML 预览只在 !loaded 时显示 “Loading preview…”，viewer 若既没有 onError 也不完成 load（例如 worker 被运行环境包装后丢消息），界面会无限等待且没有失败回退。旧版 Office iframe 路径则定义了 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000。file-preview-content.tsx 只对 office（iframe）分支有超时，ooxml 分支没有。

实际影响
预览链路的任何挂起都会表现为“永远加载”，用户与自动化都拿不到成功或失败的确定结果，问题也难以归因。
建议改法
为 OOXML 预览加入与旧 Office 一致的加载超时（例如复用 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS），超时后走 viewerError → 下载回退。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
OOXML viewer 未触发 onError 但也未完成 load（包括运行环境包装 Worker 导致消息丢失）。
应有能力 / 行为
超过加载阈值后进入显式失败态并提供下载回退。
实际观察
只有 onError 才失败；否则永久显示 Loading preview…，没有任何超时。
应用绕行与代价
无框架级绕行；本次由 QA 用原生 Worker 实验证明实现可渲染，并把该现象记为环境阻塞。
改进后的验收标准
在 viewer 不响应时，15s（或配置阈值）内出现失败提示与下载入口。

      return <MarkdownPreview text={text} />;
    case 'text':
      return (
        <pre className='max-h-[70vh] overflow-auto whitespace-pre-wrap rounded-md bg-muted p-3 text-sm'>
          {text ??
            t('files.loadingPreview', { defaultValue: 'Loading preview...' })}
        </pre>
      );
    default:
      return <DownloadFallback file={file} onDownload={onDownload} />;
  }

上游 Issue 草稿 · Markdown
### [轻微][易用性改进] OfficeOpenXmlPreview 没有加载超时，viewer 卡住时会永久停在 Loading preview…

**相关对象**：`@nocobase/app-plugin-file`（评审时 0.1.0-beta.16）

OOXML 预览只在 !loaded 时显示 “Loading preview…”，viewer 若既没有 onError 也不完成 load（例如 worker 被运行环境包装后丢消息），界面会无限等待且没有失败回退。旧版 Office iframe 路径则定义了 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000。file-preview-content.tsx 只对 office（iframe）分支有超时，ooxml 分支没有。

**影响**：预览链路的任何挂起都会表现为“永远加载”，用户与自动化都拿不到成功或失败的确定结果，问题也难以归因。

**建议改动**：为 OOXML 预览加入与旧 Office 一致的加载超时（例如复用 OFFICE_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS），超时后走 viewerError → 下载回退。

**验收标准**：在 viewer 不响应时，15s（或配置阈值）内出现失败提示与下载入口。

**评审时证据（冻结快照）**：
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:61–99` — kind==="image" 直接返回裸 <img src={url}>，没有 onError/失败态；error 只在 switch 之前被处理（外部传入）。对比 office/ooxml 分支均有错误回退。
- `packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/registry/component-ui/components/previewers/office-open-xml-preview.tsx:80–113` — OOXML 预览有 viewerError/AbortController/onError 回退到下载卡片，但只在 !loaded 时无限显示 “Loading preview...”，没有像旧 Office iframe 那样的 15s 加载超时。

F6 · implement 轮次因自动压缩失败被截断，功能代码未写出，直接导致 verify-2 全项失败

工厂流程

⌄

implement 的事件流在只写出 database/main/migrations 之后触发了阈值压缩：compaction_end.aborted=false 且 errorMessage 为 “Auto-compaction failed: Summarization failed: generation hit the token cap and the summary is incomplete”，随后 stopReason=length、assistant thinking 只剩单个字符 "I"、turn_end。verify-2 report 因此描述“运行中的应用没有任何资料业务界面，/main/api/materials:list 返回 SPA HTML”，B01–B06 全失败；retro 也写明 “The browser failure was that the feature did not exist at all”。repair-2 随后写出完整功能，verify-3 B01/B03/B04/B05/B06 通过、B02 被环境阻塞。

实际影响
一轮 verify 的失败被误读为框架或实现缺陷的风险很高；实际是工厂 harness 的上下文预算/压缩机制中断了实现，浪费了一整轮 QA。
建议改法
工厂侧修复自动压缩在 token cap 下的失败回退（例如先落盘状态再分片总结、失败时保留原始消息而非仅记 errorMessage），并在回合结束时检测 stopReason=length/空 thinking 后自动续跑而非直接进入验证。
诊断 · 触发条件、应有行为、绕行代价与验收标准
触发条件
单轮上下文达到阈值触发自动压缩，且压缩生成触及 token 上限。
应有能力 / 行为
压缩失败可恢复，agent 继续完成实现；或至少标记本轮为未完成而不进入验收。
实际观察
压缩失败后回合以 length 结束、thinking 空，实现只完成迁移与 seed，随后被当作已完成进入 verify-2。
应用绕行与代价
由 repair-2 重写全部功能代码并补齐测试与注册表覆盖。
改进后的验收标准
出现压缩失败时本轮不计入完成，或自动续跑直至功能代码写出；verify 只在实现完整后进行。

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 验收机制

Seed context methods must stay attached to their object

可自动化

Destructuring `repository` from SeedContext separates a method from its receiver and trips @typescript-eslint/unbound-method; typing raw query builders as `any` trips the whole no-unsafe-* family.

建议改动

In seeds use `context.repository(...)` (or keep the method bound) and type QueryAdapter parameters with the exported `QueryAdapter` type from @nocobase/db instead of `any`.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · 工具与构建

A uuid primary key without a database default needs the id supplied by the caller

需人工判断

`Repository.createOne` builds its selector from the record and throws `INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR` when the primary key is a uuid column with no DB default and the value is omitted. A Collection Builder uuid primary key does not imply a database default, so application code must mint the id (like the File Repository's own upload path does) or declare a default in the migration.

建议改动

When the intent is an application-owned identity, set a database default (e.g. `defaultTo`/`gen_random_uuid`) in the migration, or make createOne mint a uuid for a missing primary key. Until then document the requirement on the Collection Builder uuid helper.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · 验收机制

Reset derived component state with a key instead of a setState effect

可自动化

`useEffect(() => setState(x), [dep])` trips eslint-react's `set-state-in-effect` (cascading render) and is the pattern the framework flags. Remounting the child with `key={dep}` resets its state without an effect.

建议改动

When state must reset on an identity/prop change, key the component on that value and let the remount clear the state rather than writing a setState-in-effect.

来源：Agent · retro.json

本评审只读冻结材料，按能力单元评估 NocoBase3 基础框架在 issue #543（项目资料与私有附件）中的支撑度。核心结论：框架把“文件上传/存储/元数据”与“公开字节路由”解耦得很清楚，公开字节路由被注释、文档与 Skill 一并标为“有意的例外”，并明确要求应用为受限文件自建认证；应用据此只挂 api action 并自建按 ownerId 过滤的认证字节路由，B05 私有隔离通过。不足集中在内容读取的复用性（无带主体的读取 API，应用复制安全头与流逻辑）、客户端预览失败态（图片分支无 onError）与 OOOXML 无加载超时、以及 uuid 主键身份职责在 db Skill 中未写清。verify-2 的全项失败经日志证实是 implement 轮次被自动压缩截断、功能代码未写出（工厂侧），repair-2 后 verify-3 除 B02 外均通过；B02 是 agent-browser 包装 window.Worker 造成的环境阻塞。评审未发现导致验收失败的框架实现缺陷，但识别出若干可复用性与健壮性改进点。

NocoBase3 插件 · @nocobase/app-plugin-file · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/docs/README.md

⌄

defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes 把 actions、必填 policy、principal 解析、disk 与 accessPath 组合成一套契约：上传路径由 store() 合成全部值（randomUUID、objects/<id>.<ext>、文件名清洗、size 一致性校验），Policy 以 create.scope/defaults 约束且只做必要放宽；accessPath 下的公开字节路由被注释与 docs/README 明确标为“有意的例外”。Skill 进一步指出受限文件应由应用自建认证并保留其余授权检查，同时明确“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。

提供的帮助
应用无需重建文件模块即可获得安全的字节落盘与元数据，且能按文档把私有化责任放在应用侧，避免误把公开路由当安全边界。
应保留的能力
保持该契约；可考虑把 material-content.ts 这类“认证字节路由”抽成官方可复用模式或示例，减少重复实现。

E1 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.d.ts:13–33

FileRepositoryApiExposure 声明 name/collection/disk/accessPath/accessMode/policy/actions；policy 注释明确写出 accessPath 下的公共字节路由是“故意的例外”，无自身认证、不受 Policy 约束，应用需自行为受限文件加认证。

export interface FileRepositoryApiExposure<P = unknown> {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly collection?: string;
    readonly connection?: string;
    readonly disk: string;
    readonly accessPath?: string;
    readonly accessMode?: 'stream' | 'redirect';
    /**
     * The Policy every action of this exposure runs under, including uploads.
     *
     * `uploadOne` and `uploadMany` do not go through `defineRepositoryApiRoutes`
     * — they compose their own values and call the Repository directly — so what
     * they bind is derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are
     * inherited, and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns, which
     * is the only thing a caller cannot influence here. See `uploadPolicy`.
     *
     * The public byte route under `accessPath` is the deliberate exception. It
     * serves anyone holding the UUID, has no authentication of its own, and is
     * unaffected by this Policy.
     */
    readonly policy: RepositoryPolicy | ((principal: P) => RepositoryPolicy);

E2 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/routes.js:188–220

defineRootRoutes 中的公共内容路由实现：UUID 正则、files.findOne、disk.exists、Cache-Control private no-store、nosniff/CSP、Content-Disposition、disk.getStream 流式返回；它就是应用若要私有化时必须自行重写的那段逻辑。

        defineRootRoutes((app) => {
            const router = fileRouter();
            for (const entry of entries) {
                const files = resolve(app, entry, unwritablePolicy);
                router.get(`${entry.accessPath}/:file`, async (c) => {
                    const match = /^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?:\.([a-z0-9]{1,32}))?$/.exec(c.req.param('file'));
                    if (!match)
                        return c.notFound();
                    const record = await files.findOne({ filter: { id: match[1] } });
                    if (!record || record.ext !== (match[2] ?? ''))
                        return c.notFound();
                    const disk = app.container
                        .resolve(driveManagerToken)
                        .use(record.disk);
                    if (!(await disk.exists(record.key)))
                        return c.notFound();
                    c.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
                    if (entry.accessMode === 'redirect') {
                        const url = await files.getStorageUrl(record);
                        const publicBasePath = app.publicBasePath ?? '';
                        // Check the final target after the host rewrites root-relative redirects.
                        const location = new URL(addBasePathToLocation(url, publicBasePath), c.req.url);
                        if (location.origin === new URL(c.req.url).origin &&
                            entries.some((item) => location.pathname.startsWith(`${joinBasePath(publicBasePath, item.accessPath)}/`)))
                            throw new FileRepositoryError('STORAGE_URL_UNAVAILABLE', 'Storage URL points back to a file access route.');
                        return c.redirect(url, 302);
                    }
                    c.header('Content-Type', validMime(record.mimeType));
                    c.header('Content-Length', String(record.size));
                    c.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
                    c.header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox; default-src 'none'");
                    c.header('Content-Disposition', `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''${encodeURIComponent(Buffer.from(record.filename).toString('utf8')).replace(/['()*]/g, (char) => `%${char.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`)}`);
                    return c.body(Readable.toWeb(await disk.getStream(record.key)));

E3 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/dist/server/repository.d.ts:16–43

FileOperations 仅暴露 validateCollection/uploadOne/uploadMany/getUrl/getStorageUrl，没有按主体读取内容的流式 API；FILE_COLUMNS 固定九列；uploadPolicy 说明上传路径如何从 exposure 的 Policy 派生。

export interface FileOperations {
    validateCollection(): Promise<void>;
    uploadOne(input: UploadOneInput): Promise<UploadOneResult>;
    uploadMany(input: UploadManyInput): Promise<UploadManyResult>;
    getUrl(record: Pick<FileRecord, 'id' | 'ext'>): string;
    getStorageUrl(record: Pick<FileRecord, 'disk' | 'key'>): Promise<string>;
}
export type ServerFileRepository = Repository<FileRecord> & FileOperations;
/**
 * The columns a file Collection must provide, which are also the columns
 * `store()` composes for every upload.
 */
export declare const FILE_COLUMNS: readonly ["id", "disk", "key", "filename", "ext", "mimeType", "size", "createdAt", "updatedAt"];
/**
 * The Policy the upload path binds, derived from the exposure's own.
 *
 * It is derived rather than used as it stands because an upload supplies no
 * caller fields at all — `store()` composes every value — so a field allowlist
 * has nothing to constrain here and the plugin substitutes its own columns.
 * What is inherited is exactly the two dimensions that do not describe caller
 * input: which rows this principal may produce (`scope`), and what the server
 * stamps onto them (`defaults`). A `create` that is `false` stays `false`, so
 * an exposure that forbids creating rows forbids uploading them too.
 *
 * This is the only place a Policy is widened, and the reason is specific to
 * this path. It licenses nothing elsewhere.
 */
export declare function uploadPolicy(base: RepositoryPolicy): RepositoryPolicy;

    required(options = {}) {
        return async (context, next) => {
            const originFailure = await this.checkCookieWriteOrigin(context);
            if (originFailure)
                return originFailure;
            if (options.skip?.(context)) {
                await next();
                return;
            }
            let auth;
            try {
                auth = await this.getSession(context.req.raw.headers);
                // A refused credential is Better Auth's APIError; answer with its own status and body.
            }
            catch (error) {
                if (error instanceof APIError) {
                    return context.json(error.body ?? { code: error.status, message: error.message }, error.statusCode);
                }
                throw error;
            }
            if (!auth) {
                return context.json({
                    code: 'UNAUTHORIZED',
                    message: 'Authentication required',
                }, 401);
            }
            context.set('auth', auth);
            await next();
        };
    }

export function recordSelector(collection, record) {
    const constraint = identityConstraints(collection).find((candidate) => candidate.fields.every((field) => record[field] !== undefined && record[field] !== null));
    if (!constraint) {
        throw new RepositoryError('INVALID_UNIQUE_SELECTOR', 'Repository record requires a complete, non-null primary or unconditional unique selector.', { collection: collection.name });
    }
    return {
        kind: 'unique',
        fields: [...constraint.fields],
        values: Object.fromEntries(constraint.fields.map((field) => [field, record[field]])),
    };
}
export function createdRecordSelector(collection, values, returned) {
    const record = { ...values };
    const generated = (collection.fields ?? []).filter((field) => !('target' in field) &&
        (field.autoIncrement || field.type === 'increments'));
    const insertId = Array.isArray(returned) ? returned[0] : undefined;
    // Drivers without RETURNING may supply one generated numeric identity, not a value for every primary field.
    if (generated.length === 1 &&
        (typeof insertId === 'number' ||
            typeof insertId === 'string' ||
            typeof insertId === 'bigint')) {
        const field = generated[0].name;
        if (record[field] === undefined)
            record[field] = insertId;
    }
    return recordSelector(collection, record);

E16 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-file/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-file/SKILL.md:118–126

Skill 明确：action 由 policy 管，accessPath 下的内容路由是公开例外；“For restricted files, register App-owned authentication … before mounting it”；“missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes”。

Only declared POST `/api/<name>:<action>` operations are exposed. Ordinary actions are `findMany/findOne/count/exists/aggregate/groupBy/createOne/updateOne/deleteOne`. There are no createMany/updateMany/deleteMany HTTP actions.

`policy` is required and governs every action of the exposure, uploads included. It is a Repository Policy: `read`, `create`, `update` and `delete`, each `true`, `false`, or a rule node. A node that is `false` refuses that operation; a node with no `fields` accepts no caller-supplied field, which is what a metadata `createOne` needs before it will accept anything. Pass a function of the principal — `policy: (principal) => ({ ... })` — together with a `principal(context)` resolver to scope rows to the caller; without a principal the request is refused with 403.

An upload supplies no caller fields, so it binds a Policy derived from this one: the `create` scope and defaults are inherited and the field allowlist is replaced by the file columns. `create: false` therefore forbids uploading as well as creating metadata, and a `create.defaults` of `{ ownerId }` is stamped onto uploaded rows — which is what keeps an uploaded file inside the same scope `findMany` reads. The content route under `accessPath` is the exception: it is public and this Policy does not reach it.

Content is GET `<accessPath>/<uuid>.<ext>` outside `/api`, omitting the dot when extensionless. Stream returns full bytes as an attachment; redirect returns a public storage URL or a five-minute signed URL. A disk without URL support requires stream mode; there is no automatic fallback.

These are public routes. For restricted files, register App-owned authentication and authorization on the paths each contribution owns before mounting it — `/<name>:<action>` per exposed API action, `<accessPath>/*` for content. Never `router.use('*', ...)` in a contribution router: contributions share the mounted router, so it also guards the SPA and every contribution mounted after yours. Check the operation and record/parent-record access; a login page, private disk, Client filter or Policy field allowlist is not authentication. Add scoped middleware and principal-based Policy to the generated routes first. If an existing contract needs an adapter, extend that module using the public Server manager and retain its authorization checks; missing built-in authentication alone is not a reason to replace the routes. Never trust browser-supplied ownership.

E17 · packages/@nocobase/app-plugin-authentication/skills/nocobase-app-plugin-authentication/references/protecting-routes.md:39–68

指引给出 auth.required()/auth.optional() 的 401 行为、AuthEnv 形状、skip 选项与 getSession 语义。

## The two middlewares

- `auth.required()` rejects an anonymous request with `401` and the body
  `{ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED', message: 'Authentication required' }`. On success
  `context.get('auth')` is `{ user, session }`.
- `auth.optional()` sets `context.get('auth')` to the session or `null` and
  never rejects. Use it for a route whose response differs for a signed-in
  caller but is still public.

Both accept `{ skip: (context) => boolean }` to exempt specific requests, for
example a health probe inside an otherwise protected prefix. A skipped request
has no `auth` variable at all; read it only after checking.

`AuthEnv` is `{ Variables: { auth: AuthSession } }`. Type the router with it so
`context.get('auth')` compiles. `AuthSession` is `{ user, session } | null`;
`user` carries `id`, `name`, `email`, `emailVerified`, `username`, `image`,
`disabledAt`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, plus any `user.additionalFields` the
application configured.

## What a session means

`auth.getSession(headers)` is what both middlewares call. It asks Better Auth
for the cookie's session and then re-reads the user row: a user that no longer
exists or has `disabledAt` set yields `null` even though the cookie is still
valid. That is why disabling an account takes effect immediately for HTTP.

Use `getSession` directly when you have a `Request` but no Hono context, for
example in a WebSocket upgrade or a job that validates a caller-supplied
request. Do not call Better Auth's `api.getSession` yourself; it skips the
disabled check.

E18 · packages/@nocobase/db/skills/nocobase-db/SKILL.md:242–249

db Skill 的边界清单：包含 “Do not assume an `id` exists…”；但没有说明 uuid 主键在未声明数据库默认值时必须由调用方提供 id。

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
- Do not assume an `id` exists, and do not infer a field's type, primary key or auto-increment from its name.

`accessPath` 下的内容路由是有意的例外：它在 `/api` 之外、没有认证，Policy 不覆盖它。普通 action 复用 `defineRepositoryApiRoutes()` 的协议。

/**
 * The upload endpoint for material attachments.
 *
 * The bytes, the `objects/<uuid>` key, the metadata row and the File Repository's collection validation all come
 * from `@nocobase/app-plugin-file`; this module only says which exposure is open and who may use it. The upload is
 * an ordinary File Repository `uploadOne` action, reachable as `POST /api/materialFiles:uploadOne`, and the returned
 * record already carries a `contentUrl`.
 *
 * The plugin's routes are "application-owned" by design: it ships no authentication. It is wrapped here so that
 * `auth.required()` runs on the one path this application exposes before the plugin's own router sees the request,
 * and so the plugin's public byte route (which serves anyone holding a UUID) is never mounted. The authenticated
 * byte route lives in `material-content.ts`.
 */
const NAME = 'materialFiles';
const COLLECTION = 'material_files';
const ACCESS_PATH = '/uploads/materials';

/** The file columns the Plugin's upload path binds as the create allowlist; kept in step with the fixed file columns. */
const FILE_COLUMNS = [
  'id',
  'disk',
  'key',
  'filename',
  'ext',
  'mimeType',
  'size',
  'createdAt',
  'updatedAt',
] as const;

interface Principal {
  readonly id: string;
}

/** Every row this principal may read or produce belongs to them, and every upload is stamped with their id. */
const policy = (principal: Principal): RepositoryPolicy => ({
  read: { scope: { ownerId: principal.id }, fields: [...FILE_COLUMNS] },
  create: {
    scope: { ownerId: principal.id },
    defaults: { ownerId: principal.id },
  },
  update: false,
  delete: false,
});

const [pluginApiRoute] = defineFileRepositoryApiRoutes<Principal>({
  principal: (context) => {
    const session = (context as Context<AuthEnv>).get('auth');
    return session ? { id: session.user.id } : null!;
  },
  repositories: [
    {
      name: NAME,
      collection: COLLECTION,
      disk: 'local',
      accessPath: ACCESS_PATH,
      policy,
      actions: { uploadOne: { maxSize: 20 * 1024 * 1024 } },
    },
  ],
});

export default defineApiRoutes(async (app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);

  // Scoped to the exact action path this application exposes: no wildcard, so nothing the plugin may add later is
  // authenticated by accident, and no other contribution's path is affected.
  router.use(`/${NAME}:uploadOne`, auth.required());
  router.route('/', await pluginApiRoute.createRouter(app));

  // `defineApiRoutes` returns a plain `Hono`; the typed router is mounted into one so the
  // handlers keep their `AuthEnv` context (`context.get('auth')`) without widening it away.
  const root = new Hono();
  root.route('/', router);
  return root;
});

/**
 * The authenticated byte route for material attachments.
 *
 * The File Repository's own byte route is deliberately public — it serves anyone holding the UUID and is not
 * reached by a Policy. The product requires the opposite: an attachment belongs to the user who uploaded it, and
 * neither a colleague with the link nor a signed-out visitor may read it. So this application serves the bytes
 * itself, from the same `local` disk the upload wrote to, and looks the record up with the caller's id in the
 * filter. A missing record, another user's record and a non-`png`/`docx` record are indistinguishable: all 404.
 */

const UUID =
  /^([0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12})(?:\.([a-z0-9]{1,32}))?$/;

const MIME_TYPES: Readonly<Record<string, string>> = {
  png: 'image/png',
  docx: 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document',
};

export default defineRootRoutes((app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);

  router.get('/uploads/materials/:file', auth.required(), async (context) => {
    const session = context.get('auth');
    if (!session) return context.json({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' }, 401);

    const match = UUID.exec(context.req.param('file'));
    if (!match) return context.notFound();

    const [, id, extension = ''] = match;
    if (!(extension in MIME_TYPES)) return context.notFound();

    const database = app.container.resolve(databaseManagerToken);
    const record = await database
      .repository<MaterialAttachmentRecord>('material_files')
      .findOne({ filter: { id, ownerId: session.user.id } });
    if (!record || record.ext !== extension) return context.notFound();

    const disk = app.container.resolve(driveManagerToken).use(record.disk);
    if (!(await disk.exists(record.key))) return context.notFound();

    const filename = encodeURIComponent(
      Buffer.from(record.filename).toString('utf8'),
    ).replace(
      /['()*]/g,
      (char) => `%${char.charCodeAt(0).toString(16).toUpperCase()}`,
    );

    context.header('Cache-Control', 'private, no-store');
    context.header('Content-Type', MIME_TYPES[extension]);
    context.header('Content-Length', String(record.size));
    context.header('X-Content-Type-Options', 'nosniff');
    context.header('Content-Security-Policy', "sandbox; default-src 'none'");
    context.header(
      'Content-Disposition',
      `attachment; filename*=UTF-8''${filename}`,
    );
    return context.body(Readable.toWeb(await disk.getStream(record.key)));
  });

E23 · app/server/routes/materials.ts:16–56

materials API 全部 auth.required()，按 owner 作用域；文档说明 contentUrl 指向 app-owned 认证字节路由，并解释额外的 :list 兼容别名。

/**
 * The materials API.
 *
 * This is deliberately not a generic Repository route: a material and its attachments are saved together, and the
 * save has to enforce the title rule and the ownership of every attachment. All operations require a signed-in user,
 * and every one is scoped by that user's id, so a colleague holding a direct link gets a 404 rather than another
 * user's record.
 *
 * Attachment responses carry a `contentUrl` that points at the application-owned, authenticated byte route.
 * `material-content.ts` serves those bytes; the File Repository's own public byte route is never mounted.
 *
 * Two read aliases (`/materials:list` and `/materialFiles:list`) return the same JSON as the REST reads. They exist
 * because a NocoBase 2 convention still probes `<resource>:list`; returning a resource instead of the SPA fallback
 * makes that probe see the feature, and neither alias can read a row the caller does not own.
 */
export default defineApiRoutes((app: Application) => {
  const router = new Hono<AuthEnv>();
  const auth = app.container.resolve(authenticationToken);
  const materials = () => app.container.resolve(materialsToken);
  const publicBasePath = (app.publicBasePath ?? '').replace(/\/$/, '');

  const contentUrl = (attachment: MaterialAttachmentRecord): string =>
    `${publicBasePath}/uploads/materials/${encodeURIComponent(attachment.id)}${
      attachment.ext ? `.${encodeURIComponent(attachment.ext)}` : ''
    }`;

  const presentAttachment = (attachment: MaterialAttachmentRecord) => ({
    ...attachment,
    contentUrl: contentUrl(attachment),
  });

  const present = (material: MaterialWithAttachments) => ({
    id: material.id,
    title: material.title,
    createdAt: material.createdAt,
    updatedAt: material.updatedAt,
    attachments: material.attachments.map(presentAttachment),
  });

  const ownerId = (context: Context<AuthEnv>): string | undefined =>
    context.get('auth')?.user.id;

E25 · app/client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/components/previewers/file-preview-content.tsx:104–159

应用在 app-owned 注册表副本中新增 ImagePreview：捕获 onError 并给出 role=alert 的损坏提示与下载按钮——因为框架默认图片预览没有失败态。

/**
 * An image preview that admits when it cannot decode the bytes.
 *
 * The `<img>` this replaces had no failure state: a damaged PNG kept the browser's broken-image icon (or, in some
 * browsers, nothing) and the surrounding chrome still showed the filename as though the preview had succeeded. A
 * corrupt upload has to be reported as a failed preview, so this tracks the load error and replaces the image with an
 * alert that says the content is damaged, keeping the download action available so the user can still inspect it.
 */
function ImagePreview(inputProps: {
  readonly file: FileRecord;
  readonly url?: string;
  readonly onDownload?: () => void;
}): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation('@nocobase/app-plugin-file');
  const { file, url, onDownload } = inputProps;
  const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false);

  if (failed) {
    return (
      <div
        role='alert'
        className='flex flex-col items-center gap-3 py-8 text-center'
      >
        <ImageOff
          aria-hidden='true'
          className='size-10 text-muted-foreground'
        />
        <p className='font-medium'>
          {t('files.imageFailed', {
            defaultValue: 'This image cannot be displayed',
          })}
        </p>
        <p className='max-w-md text-sm text-muted-foreground'>
          {t('files.imageFailedDescription', {
            defaultValue:
              'The file is saved, but it is damaged or not a readable image, so it cannot be previewed. Download it to inspect it.',
          })}
        </p>
        {onDownload ? (
          <Button type='button' onClick={onDownload}>
            {t('files.downloadFile', { defaultValue: 'Download file' })}
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <img
      src={url}
      alt={file.filename}
      className='max-h-[70vh] max-w-full object-contain'
      onError={() => setFailed(true)}
    />
  );
}

E26 · app/client/pages/materials/material-form.tsx:35–123

表单把上传与保存拆成两次提交：标题校验失败时不重置已选 FileRecord；上传状态经 onStatusChange 暴露；注释解释“Removing a record here only unlinks it”。

/**
 * The create and edit form for a material: one required title and a set of already-uploaded attachments.
 *
 * Uploading and saving are two different submissions, which is the behaviour the product asks for. A file is
 * uploaded to the File Repository the moment it is chosen, so a save rejected for a missing title leaves both the
 * upload and the selection untouched — the same `FileRecord`s stay in state and the next save links them without a
 * second upload. Removing a record here only unlinks it; the File Repository's metadata is kept, because the
 * product asks for detachment, not destruction.
 */

export interface MaterialFormDialogProps {
  readonly open: boolean;
  readonly onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  readonly material?: Material;
  readonly onSaved: (material: Material) => void;
}

const ACCEPTED_EXTENSIONS: readonly string[] = ['.png', '.docx'];
const MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE = 20 * 1024 * 1024;

export function MaterialFormDialog({
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  material,
  onSaved,
}: MaterialFormDialogProps): ReactElement {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const api = useApiClient();
  const toaster = useToaster();
  const manager = useService(clientFileRepositoryManagerToken);
  const repository = useMemo(
    () => manager.repository('materialFiles'),
    [manager],
  );

  const [title, setTitle] = useState(material?.title ?? '');
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<readonly FileRecord[]>(
    material?.attachments ?? [],
  );
  const [titleError, setTitleError] = useState(false);
  const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);
  const [uploadStatus, setUploadStatus] = useState<
    'idle' | 'uploading' | 'error'
  >('idle');

  const reportUploadError = useCallback(
    (error: Error) => {
      toaster.show({
        type: 'error',
        title: t('materials.uploadFailed'),
        description: error.message,
      });
    },
    [t, toaster],
  );

  const submit = async (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>): Promise<void> => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const nextTitle = title.trim();
    if (!nextTitle) {
      setTitleError(true);
      return;
    }
    if (uploadStatus === 'uploading') {
      toaster.show({ type: 'info', title: t('materials.waitForUpload') });
      return;
    }

    const input = { title: nextTitle, attachmentIds: files.map((f) => f.id) };
    setSaving(true);
    try {
      const saved = material
        ? await updateMaterial(api, material.id, input)
        : await createMaterial(api, input);
      setSaving(false);
      toaster.show({
        type: 'success',
        title: material ? t('materials.updated') : t('materials.created'),
      });
      onSaved(saved);
    } catch (cause) {
      setSaving(false);
      toaster.show({
        type: 'error',
        title: t('materials.saveFailed'),
        description: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : undefined,
      });
    }
  };

甲上传 PNG 并保存资料，刷新后能看到真实图片，并能下载打开。

实际操作

  1. 以资料员甲 clerk.jia 登录 $FACTORY_BROWSER_URL，进入 Materials 页面，点击 New material
  2. 在新建资料弹窗通过文件输入上传 fixtures/sample.png，标题填 'B01 Site photo'，点击 Save
  3. 页面提示 'Material created.'，列表出现该资料；随后完整刷新 /main/materials，点击该资料 View 打开详情
  4. 在详情弹窗确认图片渲染，并检查 img.naturalWidth/naturalHeight 与内容 URL；点击 Download 触发下载

观察结果

  1. 上传后新建弹窗显示已选文件 sample.png 与 Remove 按钮，保存返回 'Material created.'，列表出现 'B01 Site photo'（Attachments: 1）
  2. 刷新后资料仍存在；详情弹窗内 img src=/main/uploads/materials/3290f5d9-8de4-41c2-be26-07f3d0dc4b2a.png，naturalWidth=32 naturalHeight=32，visible=true，说明是真实图片而非占位
  3. 点击 Download 通过 agent-browser download 保存成功，得到 99 字节文件；sha256=eafcdecc1468f7b18a15a7d22c494ab7e14a435f0560798ad463efc5e14f3490，与 fixtures/sample.png 完全一致，file 识别为 PNG image data, 32 x 32

02

甲上传 DOCX 并保存，刷新后在应用内看到文档正文，而非只有文件名或下载按钮。

环境受阻：本轮 agent-browser 对页面全局 Worker 构造器做了包装（window.Worker 不再是原生实现）。该包装对 module + blob worker 会在 worker 脚本就绪前丢弃主线程立即 postMessage 的第一批消息（init/parse），因此应用内 @silurus/ooxml 的 DOCX 预览一直停在 'Loading preview...'。用原生 Worker 复现同一 module blob worker 时消息立即送达且 wasm 请求 200，预览可正常渲染；这是测试环境/工具对 Worker 的限制，不是应用业务实现问题，按验收要求标 blocked。

  4. 对比实验（不改源码）：用原生 Worker 构造 module blob worker 立即 postMessage，消息立即送达且成功 fetch /main/assets/docx_parser_bg-*.wasm(200,1830381B)；用 agent-browser 当前 wrapper 的 window.Worker 做同一实验，消息被完全丢弃
  5. 把页面 window.Worker 暂时换回原生实现（仅浏览器内验证，不改源码）后重新打开 Preview：加载结束，渲染出 canvas(823x1065) 与文本层 'Factory DOCX sample'

观察结果

  1. 上传/保存/刷新均成功，说明附件与资料持久化正常
  2. 未绕过工具限制时：预览长时间停留在 'Loading preview...'，DOM 中 [data-office-open-xml-format=docx] 容器为空、无 canvas、无正文文本
  3. 实验证明原因在测试工具：window.Worker 被 agent-browser 包装；原生 module blob worker 立即收到消息并成功请求 wasm(200)，包装后的同一 worker 收不到消息（[]）
  4. 用原生 Worker 绕过工具包装后，应用预览正常渲染，正文文本层为 'Factory DOCX sample'，canvas 823x1065，证明业务实现可渲染 DOCX 正文
